param.name: alignment
param.label: Input alignment file
param.help: Alignment in PHYLIP, FASTA, NEXUS, CLUSTAL or MSF format

param.name: model_spec
param.label: Substitution model
param.help: Choose a specific model or let IQ-TREE find the best-fit model
param.option: ModelFinder Plus (MFP) - find best-fit model and infer tree (recommended)
ModelFinder Plus (MF) - find best-fit model only
TEST - standard model selection and tree inference
TESTMERGE - find best partitioning scheme and infer tree
TESTMERGEONLY - find best partitioning scheme only
MFP+MERGE - extended model selection with partition merging and tree inference
MF+MERGE - extended model selection with partition merging only

param.name: custom_model
param.label: Custom model string
param.help: e.g. GTR+I+G for DNA, LG+F+G for protein. See IQ-TREE documentation for full syntax

param.name: bb
param.label: Ultrafast bootstrap replicates
param.help: Number of replicates (>=1000) for ultrafast bootstrap (UFBoot)

param.name: alrt
param.label: SH-aLRT replicates
param.help: Number of replicates (>=1000) for SH-like approximate likelihood ratio test. Use 0 for parametric aLRT

param.name: b
param.label: Nonparametric bootstrap replicates
param.help: Standard nonparametric bootstrap (recommended >=100). Performs bootstrap, analysis on original alignment, and consensus tree

param.name: bnni
param.label: Optimize UFBoot trees by NNI
param.help: Additional NNI optimization of UFBoot trees. Recommended under severe model violations. Increases runtime ~2-fold

param.name: nstop
param.label: Number of unsuccessful iterations to stop

param.name: pers
param.label: Perturbation strength
param.help: Between 0 and 1 for randomized NNI. DEFAULT: 0.5

param.name: allnni
param.label: Thorough NNI search
param.help: Consider all possible NNIs instead of only those near previously applied NNIs

param.name: fast
param.label: Fast tree search
param.help: Construct two starting trees (parsimony and BIONJ) and optimize by NNI only

param.name: n
param.label: Number of iterations
param.help: Specify number of iterations to stop. Overrides -nstop criterion

param.name: seed
param.label: Random seed
param.help: Specify a random number seed to reproduce a previous run

param.name: quiet
param.label: Quiet mode
param.help: Suppress printing to screen. Log file is still written

param.name: keep_ident
param.label: Keep identical sequences
param.help: By default IQ-TREE removes identical sequences and adds them back at the end

param.name: safe
param.label: Safe numerical mode
param.help: Avoid numerical underflow for large datasets with many sequences

param.name: redo
param.label: Redo entire analysis
param.help: Overwrite all existing output files and redo the entire analysis
